supporting_observations.claim: The large outbound transfer evidenced in the window occurred at 13:49:49 UTC, slightly later than the alert's approximate 13:46 time.
The transfer was made by the approved Vaultline agent running as svc-bkp, with a command line specifying the Nightly job and the approved ingest.vaultline-backup.com target.
The proxy recorded a 640,000,000-byte client-to-server transfer to ingest.vaultline-backup.com, and network telemetry attributes the corresponding proxy traffic to the Vaultline agent process.
The destination, agent, service account, and several-hundred-megabyte transfer size match the organization's stated approved offsite backup service and expected behavior.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show an HTTPS tunnel and byte counts, but do not reveal the uploaded data's contents.
The records identify the agent by image path and process name but do not provide a file hash, signature-verification result, or other proof of binary integrity.
The records do not explicitly correlate the alert to a specific network flow; the evidenced large transfer is at 13:49:49 UTC rather than exactly around 13:46.
claims_not_established: The contents of the uploaded data and whether they were appropriate for backup are not established.
The evidence does not independently verify the Vaultline agent binary or establish that this particular run was scheduled.
unrelated_findings: At 14:19:35 UTC, PROXY-PIN-01 made an SMB connection to FILE-PIN-01 and attempted a network logon using the disabled account svc_mgmt; the attempt failed. Review separately because it is not part of the Vaultline transfer. Records: T100-00572, T100-00573, T100-00575.
